# Accepted baseline — imported ArtStation galleries

Accepted by user: **2026-11-19**.

This records the published gallery content and behavior as the working baseline; future changes should preserve them unless explicitly requested. Documentation only, with no site runtime change.

| Gallery | ArtStation source | Studio route | Personal route | Content |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vehicles – Aircrafts | `w8LJ5g` | `/galleries/vehicles-aircrafts/` | `/artur/galleries/vehicles-aircrafts/` | 23 images and four embedded Sketchfab models |
| Phantom: Covert Ops | `A9VRrq` | `/galleries/phantom-covert-ops/` | `/artur/galleries/phantom-covert-ops/` | 23 images and source gameplay video |
| Firearms | `58QBOJ` | `/galleries/firearms/` | `/artur/galleries/firearms/` | 20 images and source native MP4 |

### Preserve

- Original image order and filenames, responsive WebPs, approved original image delivery and per-image JPG retry/fallback.
- Embedded media ordering, functional native/Sketchfab/YouTube controls and fullscreen, and companion gallery embed metadata.
- DS Gallery Editor JSON compatibility and ability to reorder, save, and reopen.
- Unlisted/noindex status, absence from sitemap and homepage navigation, and independent studio/personal paths.
- Existing protected gallery access, mobile navigation, interactive maps, shared viewer, and desktop gallery transitions.

Publication and verification records: Aircrafts [PR #46](https://github.com/DigitalShamans/portfolio-media/pull/46), Phantom [PR #50](https://github.com/DigitalShamans/portfolio-media/pull/50), Firearms [PR #59](https://github.com/DigitalShamans/portfolio-media/pull/59).
